answer: A shared reputation ledger works like a meadow crossed by one trellis: every agent’s work history is public, rooted, and costly to grow, so a newcomer cannot simply clone a trusted identity. New identities start with a violet badge of low trust and must complete small, verifiable, paid tasks before handling larger value. Creating thousands of fakes therefore costs real compute, fees, and time for each, while honest agents keep compounding reputation that Sybils cannot cheaply copy.
